title: SBR-2: Hot-State Adversarial Exam — Governance Invariants Hold During Active Learning (Trajectory Identity, 20/20 Probes Rejected)
description:
SBR-2 — Hot-State Adversarial Exam: the first adversarial examination of the bounded-learning hemispheric mesh in its HOT state (mid-epoch, weights in flight). A preregistered, non-adaptive 5-probe battery (forged authority, under-confidence heal with adversarial confidence payload, orphan lineage injections attacking the journaled-crossing invariant, runtime playbook mutation, forged roster row) fired at epochs 5/15/25/35 of the T2C-converged 40-epoch bounded training regime.

All 5 falsifiers PASS. Governance roster SHA byte-identical through every adversarial epoch (H-INV-1); 20/20 probes journaled with zero mesh deltas attributable to any probe (H-INV-2); zero side effects; and trajectory identity — the adversarial run's weight-vector trajectory is byte-identical epoch-for-epoch to a clean control run. Adversarial load could not nudge a single weight mid-learning.

Scope honesty: proves THIS registered instrument (frozen corpus, 32-node mesh, frozen 3-playbook roster, bounded learning rule) under THIS frozen probe battery only — not a universal production claim. No adaptive probing, no re-runs. The preregistration records operator authorization as GO + timestamp per the operator-privacy doctrine effective 2026-10-13; a redaction note is disclosed in-place. Complements SBR-1 (at-rest exam, DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23331224), AUTH-1 (channel authority, DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23332203), XPLAT-5 (engine parity, DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23332291): the invariance evidence now includes adversary-present-during-learning.

Dual Mesh Benchmark: MEASURED for the DeepSeek column (DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23345241); all other figures NOT MEASURED.

This software is a prototype and is provided for educational and research purposes only. It is not intended for production use, commercial deployment, or safety-critical environments. All systems are experimental and may contain defects.
